title: AI-Pattern-Mining-Project
summary: A code-pattern-mining project that clusters and catalogs auto-generated Python code snippets, including artifacts scraped from the synthetic-data-generator (sdgx) repository. Those mined snippets contain docstrings referencing sdgx's vendored `sdv_ctgan` CTGANSynthesizer and a GaussianMultivariate copula wrapper, so SDV-lineage ctgan and copulas code appears only as inherited third-party artifacts within the mined corpus, never invoked by this repository itself.
needs: No README; unclear whether this repo executes any SDV-family code or merely stores mined code artifacts from sdgx; component attribution (ctgan/copulas) inferred solely from docstrings in generated files.
